title.en: I am Every Woman (Rakhi Nariani Shirke)

text.en: A poem that praises the many roles a woman plays and her courage.

The poet describes a woman as a symbol of power and strength. She puts her life at stake, is real and not fake, and carries her duties with care. She is ready for the summer of life even in spring and has no fear.
The poem presents women as empowered, brave and resolute, and says that respect for women matters for a nation's growth.
Notice the rhymes (strength and stake, fake and stake), the repetition of She, and words like innate, resolute and empowered.
